subject.title: fix(shared): complete avatar MIME allowlist and add subtype validation

question: Should persisted avatar data URLs remain compatible with any `image/*` subtype, or should OpenClaw intentionally restrict them to a maintained exact allowlist?
rationale: The current contract accepts all image-prefixed data URLs, while the PR silently makes existing stored values invalid; code review cannot choose that upgrade policy safely.

options.title: Preserve broad compatibility
options.body: Keep the existing `image/*` acceptance contract and limit this PR to clearly established MIME normalization or registry consistency fixes.

options.title: Adopt a strict allowlist
options.body: Approve the breaking validation policy only with a documented supported-format contract, case normalization, upgrade diagnostics or migration guidance, and real-path proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve broad compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the existing `image/*` acceptance contract and limit this PR to clearly established MIME normalization or registry consistency fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to the shared avatar policy and end-to-end upload behavior affected by the decision.
